title: OpenAI: every GPT model, the money and the IPO
dek: From GPT-4.5 to GPT-6 in 19 months, plus a confidential IPO filing, billions in losses and a race with Anthropic.
seoTitle: OpenAI timeline 2025–2026: GPT-5 to GPT-6, IPO
bigLabel: OpenAI's reported revenue for April–June 2026, with a $12.3 bn operating loss, per the Wall Street Journal

glance.what: OpenAI moved from GPT-5 in August 2025 to the GPT-6 family in September 2026, releasing a new GPT-5.x version roughly every quarter in between. It filed confidentially for an IPO in June 2026, but Sam Altman later ruled out listing this year.
glance.why: ChatGPT is the most widely used AI assistant, so OpenAI's choices on models, prices and safety set the pace for the whole industry.
glance.next: An IPO is now expected in 2027. Watch for GPT-6 updates and how OpenAI responds to Anthropic's listing next week.

forYou: Free ChatGPT users get the 'Instant' version of each new model, usually within weeks. Paid plans get the larger 'Thinking' and 'Pro' versions first.

upcoming.text: Expected IPO, per CFO Sarah Friar

events.title: GPT-4.5 'Orion'
events.summary: OpenAI releases GPT-4.5, its largest model at the time, aimed at more natural conversation. It is phased out of the API within months.

events.title: GPT-5 unifies everything
events.summary: GPT-5 combines a fast model, a deeper 'thinking' model and an automatic router into one system, replacing the separate GPT and 'o' reasoning lines.

events.title: GPT-5-Codex for coding
events.summary: A version of GPT-5 tuned for coding agents becomes the default in OpenAI's Codex tool.

events.title: GPT-5.1
events.summary: Instant and Thinking versions open a packed November in which Google and Anthropic also launch new models within days.

events.title: GPT-5.2
events.summary: OpenAI's December refresh adds a higher 'extra-high' reasoning setting.

events.title: GPT-5.3-Codex
events.summary: A dedicated coding flagship for agentic software work.

events.title: GPT-5.4 can use a computer
events.summary: GPT-5.4 Thinking and Pro launch, OpenAI's first mainline model able to operate a computer itself. Mini and nano versions follow on 17 March.

events.title: GPT-5.5 'Spud'
events.summary: OpenAI calls GPT-5.5 more efficient and better at coding. Its Instant version becomes ChatGPT's default for all users, including free users, on 5 May.

events.title: Confidential IPO filing
events.summary: Reuters reports OpenAI has filed confidentially for a US stock market listing. The Wall Street Journal later reports Q1 revenue of $5.7 bn and Q2 revenue of $6.7 bn, with large operating losses.

events.title: GPT-5.6 in three sizes
events.summary: OpenAI replaces the single flagship with three named tiers: Sol, Terra and Luna.

events.title: GPT-6 Astra
events.summary: OpenAI's sixth-generation model rolls out to approved users on 3 September and to everyone the next day, with tighter safeguards after an August warning about its cyber capabilities.

events.title: Altman: no IPO in 2026
events.summary: Sam Altman rules out a listing this year, citing safety concerns about increasingly capable AI. CFO Sarah Friar has pointed to 2027.

events.title: GPT-6 Sol and Luna
events.summary: Faster, cheaper GPT-6 models join Astra, which remains OpenAI's most capable.

events.title: Sued, and TSMC invests
events.summary: OpenAI is one of five AI companies named in a lawsuit asking a court to freeze advanced AI development. The same day, TSMC approves up to $1 bn of AI investments split between OpenAI and Anthropic, Reuters reports.
